method: Committed C is a reading aid. NONMATCHING root behavior and cited helper behavior are confirmed with arm-none-eabi-objdump -D -b binary -m arm --adjust-vma=0x01100000 against the owner-supplied image. No proprietary C or instruction sequences are copied into owned sources.

roots.behavior: Detach pending transmission queues, then drain deferred management frames. The latter require frame kind3 and a completion target, publish status1, then release ownership.
Detach the descriptor queue under the critical section; cancel kind2 descriptors and restore all other kinds in their original relative order.
Filter kind3 descriptors, invoke concrete frame cancellation with status0x20, decrement the adapter pending count and release frame and descriptor storage. Preserve other descriptor kinds.
Drain queued caller frames FIFO with status0x10003. Release slot before owner notification and decrement the correct owner counter.

Cancel the background timer, clear pending power transition, cancel four station-control timers, clear the canonical station-order queue, release the primary management template, invalidate scan visibility, clear aggregation and per-station counters and cancel each of three station timers.

The null-configuration path registers station timers, rebuilds a64-entry scan free pool, initializes primary station defaults and management template, clears pending power transition and registers background timing. The original assert-only0x0129d694 has no additional effect for a valid owned adapter.

Reject either hardware minor revision>=0x108. Major revision1 suppresses calibration upload. Otherwise an enabled calibration produces opcode0x28 and40 bytes. Publish the feature conjunction, emit opcode0x31 and144 bytes, publish country, emit the56-byte rate command0x13, then optional four-byte antenna command0x36.

Accept nonzero unicast MAC or retain an invalid address when requested. Otherwise construct00:08:22 plus three little-endian timestamp bytes. Encode capability masks into the12-byte body of opcode0xc1 and publish address after the physical transfer completion.

owned_design.frame_storage: Exclusive borrowed payload leases move into bounded ownership slots and return only in terminal events. Payload bytes copy once into the owned physical FIFO buffer when the transfer is prepared; no heap allocation.
owned_design.ordering: 101 pending queues:20 stations x5 classes, then one unclassified queue. FIFO within each queue. Cancellation events retain completion order across frame and request pools.
owned_design.release: Terminal completion decrements ownership counters before publication. A completed slot remains reserved until the event transfers its lease back to the caller. Descriptor storage releases once. has_pending_events remains true until all terminal frame and request effects have been consumed, including after command cancellation.
owned_design.late_completion: Monotonically increasing frame and descriptor identities reject stale local completions. Actual8-bit device PIDs map to canonical frame leases. Cancelled PIDs remain quarantined until their device completion arrives. Shutdown cancels physical descriptors and prevents subsequent address publication.
owned_design.transport: FirmwareCommand exposes CMD53 argument and a mutable borrow of the actual serialized FIFO frame. RadioLifecycle supplies canonical sd_controller::Host execution. Logical write completion retains the stock ignored-write-result behavior and records the physical outcome separately.
owned_design.sharing: CommandSequence and TransmitCredits reuse the canonical radio primitives. Runtime must transfer sequence and credit ownership when switching between adapter commands and radio parameter commands.
owned_design.protocol_storage: Source-owned timer generations, fixed64-entry scan storage, fixed station state, canonical StationOrderQueue and primary management-template ownership. Names of protocol fields are inferred; stock offsets are not an owned ABI.
owned_design.configuration_boundary: HardwareConfiguration accepts typed hardware revisions, EEPROM bytes and regulatory selector inputs. The owned regulatory selector performs all15 country-table lookups, indexed override and custom EEPROM-group selection, fallback and cached selection. No preselected computed rate groups or environment CPU callback are accepted. The otherwise uninitialized fourth antenna byte is deterministic zero in the owned protocol.

integration.owner: RadioLifecycle consumes Adapter<'a,F,D>, command(), finish_command(), configure(), configure_address(), root-specific cancel methods, stop_protocols() and reset_protocols().
integration.external_partition: Association message dispatch, station authentication, WPA/WPS and crypto remain with the concrete station engine. Root/lib/BUILD integration is owned by the integration agent.

tests.provenance: All packet bytes, addresses, revision inputs, timers and scan entries are synthetic.
tests.execution: Unrun by assignment. No build, formatter, linter, native comparison, SDK or camera operation was performed.

qualification: This is source-owned behavior and source evidence, not native equivalence or hardware acceptance. The scan record exposed at this boundary retains address and SSID only; full BSS payload parsing belongs to the station/network engines. Regulatory selection CPU and target-specific channel facts are documented in vendor_wireless_adapter_regulatory.evidence.json.
